footer.tagline: Simplify your meals and keep your fridge organized every day.
cookies.banner.title: Cookies & privacy
cookies.banner.body: We use essential cookies to run the site. Non-essential analytics cookies are only set if you agree.
cookies.banner.essential: Technical cookies stay on for security and session.
newsletter.title: Stay inspired in the kitchen
newsletter.subtitle: Once or twice a month: seasonal menus, ideas to cook with what you have, and Cuisenio updates. Unsubscribe in one click.
newsletter.consent: I agree to receive Cuisenio recipes and kitchen tips. I can unsubscribe anytime.
newsletter.errorConsent: Please tick the consent box to continue.
newsletter.errorGeneric: Subscription failed right now. Please try again later.
newsletter.unsubscribe.title: Newsletter unsubscribe
newsletter.unsubscribe.successHint: You will no longer receive marketing emails. You can subscribe again from the home page.
newsletter.unsubscribe.help: If this keeps failing, reach out via the footer.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.intro: Cuisenio only collects data needed for your account, security, and, with consent, the newsletter.
legal.privacy.s1.title: Data we collect
legal.privacy.s1.p1: Account: email, display name, BCrypt-hashed password. Optional: profile photo, preferences.
legal.privacy.s1.p2: Newsletter: email + consent timestamp + unsubscribe token. No ad profiling.
legal.privacy.s2.title: Purposes & legal basis
legal.privacy.s2.p1: Contract (account, recipes, plans), legitimate interest (security), consent (newsletter, analytics cookies).
legal.privacy.s3.title: Your rights
legal.privacy.s3.p1: Access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability. Contact the controller via the footer.
legal.privacy.s4.title: Retention
legal.privacy.s4.p1: Active account: account lifetime. Newsletter: until unsubscribe. Technical logs: limited duration.
legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.terms.intro: By using Cuisenio you accept these terms. The service is provided for portfolio demo and personal use.
legal.terms.s1.title: Account & security
legal.terms.s1.p1: You are responsible for credential confidentiality. Passwords are stored hashed. Abuse may lead to suspension.
legal.terms.s2.title: Content & recipes
legal.terms.s2.p1: You keep rights to published content. Cuisenio may moderate reported content.
legal.terms.s3.title: Pro subscription
legal.terms.s3.p1: Pro Pass (Stripe Test) unlocks advanced features. No real charge outside documented sandbox setup.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie policy
legal.cookies.intro: This page explains cookies used by Cuisenio and how to manage consent.
legal.cookies.s1.title: Essential cookies
legal.cookies.s1.p1: Session, security, theme/language preference. Required to run. No marketing consent needed.
legal.cookies.s2.title: Non-essential cookies
legal.cookies.s2.p1: Optional analytics. Set only if you click Accept on the banner.
legal.cookies.s3.title: Manage my choice
legal.cookies.s3.p1: Clear localStorage key cuisenio-cookie-consent to show the banner again, or contact us.
